objective: Determine whether the trained H2 aggregation produces a pairing-dependent response that tracks a known horizontal geometric displacement, beyond what is obtained from randomized aggregation weights under the same complete statistic.
does_not_test: causal uniqueness of the learned mechanism

prerequisites.historical_records_byte_identical: historical.sha256, verified before AND after every stage
prerequisites.geom001_immutable: its own frozen.sha256 (5) and historical.sha256 (36) re-verified here

geometry.required_feature_identity: R_f[w] == L_f[w + tau] on the validated translation domain
geometry.required_anchor: V[tau, w] == 0 exactly on the valid cost-volume domain

cells.invariant: each source image exactly once as left and exactly once as right; the same tau in all four cells

statistic.margin_role: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY -- must not alter the verdict
statistic.primary: h = sum over tau of 1[k_hat_tau == tau], 0 <= h <= 6

stage_1_gate.record: the complete result for every seed
stage_1_gate.G_STOP_rule: if H_star == 6 -> verdict STATISTIC-ARCHITECTURALLY-AVAILABLE; do not load trained checkpoints; do not execute stage 2; this does NOT establish correspondence

comparison.strongest_admissible_outcome: min(h_trained) > H_star across all three trained checkpoints
comparison.if_not_exceeded: NOT-DEMONSTRATED -- not evidence of correspondence, and NOT evidence that correspondence is absent
comparison.partial: CASE C -- HETEROGENEOUS; report every checkpoint separately; pooling PROHIBITED

tracking_with_offset.condition: k_hat_tau != tau for all six tau, and k_hat_tau - tau identical across all six, for one checkpoint and scene pair
tracking_with_offset.label: TRACKING-WITH-OFFSET
tracking_with_offset.role: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- the primary h statistic is NOT redefined to count offset matches

algebraic_validation.check: AA + BB - AB - BA at the RAW COST-VOLUME level is numerically zero
algebraic_validation.claim_after_the_nonlinear_z_score: NONE -- the z-score is part of the measured statistic and is calibrated empirically by the random gate

hard_stops.HS1: feature translation fails on the validated domain (sub-checks A/B/C/D, see design.json)
hard_stops.HS3: tau differs across the four cells
hard_stops.HS4: raw cost-volume cancellation fails beyond the frozen tolerance
hard_stops.HS5: checkpoint identity, candidate count, or readout parameter count differs from the frozen specification
hard_stops.HS7: a trained aggregation checkpoint is loaded before random G-PASS
hard_stops.HS11: optimizer, backward, parameter update, or refinement is invoked

claim_ceiling.permitted_if_exceeded: Under the specified synthetic horizontal pairing intervention, the trained nonlinear aggregation-plus-readout response tracks the known geometric pairing displacement more strongly than the preregistered random-aggregation population.

immutable_rules: do not add additional tau values
do not remove difficult scene pairs
do not change the argmin rule
do not introduce an offset tolerance
do not reuse historical random-gate results
do not use the vertical arm as the primary statistic
do not select results after execution

resolutions.note: points on which the authorisation is silent. Each resolved by inheritance from a named frozen record, fixed here before execution, and argued in PREREGISTRATION.md Part B.

R1_pixel_reduction.resolution: Ibar_tau(k) = median over the 44352 masked pixels of I_tau(k,y,x)

R2_unit.resolution: unit = (aggregation instance, scene pair); gate population 3 x 6 x 32 = 576; trained population 3 x 6 = 18; H* = max over 576; primary comparison min over 18 > H*
R2_unit.authority: GEOM-001 run_geom.py stage1 unit structure and the 576-unit assertion; domain audit design.json random_gate
R2_unit.declared_ambiguity: the strongest of the two readings of 'min(h_trained) across all three checkpoints' is adopted; both the 18 unit values and the three six-vectors are reported so either reading can be applied by a reader

R3_gate_axis.resolution: stage 1 horizontal only; vertical appears in stage 2 as a diagnostic and is never compared to H*
R3_gate_axis.authority: GEOM-001 run_geom.py stage1/stage2; domain audit design.json vertical_control

R4_search_free_control.authority: the authorisation, stage 2: 'Load exactly these frozen H2 checkpoints' and 'No checkpoint selection'
R4_search_free_control.class: SCOPE REDUCTION imposed by the authorisation
R4_search_free_control.declared_cost: this record carries one null only -- the random-aggregation gate -- and no architecture-level null

R5_HS1_subchecks.resolution: HS1-A pixel construction (both arms); HS1-B Rf[w]==Lf[w+tau] exact on [15,55-tau] (horizontal); HS1-C |V[:,tau,:,15:45]| == 0.0 exact for AA and BB (horizontal); HS1-D domain non-empty, tau-independent, >= 12 wide
R5_HS1_subchecks.vertical: HS1-B and HS1-C recorded INAPPLICABLE, never as passes
R5_HS1_subchecks.class: the corrected form of the single bound that fired in GEOM-001

R7_ties_margins_rows.ties: numpy.argmin smallest index; every exact tie recorded separately in tie_events
R7_ties_margins_rows.rows: y in [64,208) retained unchanged; the derivation permits all 17 feature rows but widening after the halt would be support-shopping
